title: Troubleshoot ad order
prompt: Troubleshoot /order order for delivery issues and identify the primary causal blocker family such as setup, supply, bid competitiveness, or change pressure. Treat pacing as posture unless pacing-control / bid-allocation rejection is explicitly proven.

title: Review campaign performance
prompt: Analyze /campaign campaign performance for pacing, spend, delivery, KPI health, and the top next actions.

title: Diagnose inventory constraints
prompt: Diagnose the top inventory, supply-path, deal, site, or signal constraints hurting delivery for /order order, and explain which are most material.

title: Analyze targeting and signals
prompt: Analyze the most important targeting rules and signal effects for /campaign campaign, including restrictive selectors, impactful signals, and safer expansion options when they exist.

title: Forecast reach and availability
prompt: Forecast reach and availability for /line line.

title: Test creative rendering
prompt: Test /creative creative and show screenshot rendering, frame verdicts, and network activity.

title: Check overlap and saturation
prompt: Check overlap for /campaign campaign and distinguish shared targeting-rule usage from delivery or household saturation, then recommend how to reduce real cannibalization when it exists.

title: Build weekly summary
prompt: Create a weekly campaign health summary for /advertiser advertiser covering performance, inventory, creative, and verification highlights.

title: Build order performance report
prompt: Build me a report for order /order from ${7 days ago} through ${now} with spend, bids, impressions, CTR, eCPM, pacing, and delivery shortfall. Show headline KPIs, a daily trend chart, a bid funnel, ranked breakdown tables with data bars, status badges, findings, and recommendations.

title: Review creative fatigue
prompt: Review creative fatigue for /campaign campaign and identify which creatives should be refreshed, tested, or paused.

title: Recommend sites
prompt: Recommend sites for audience /line , including candidate additions and exclusions.

title: Send Performance Delivery Command Center
prompt: Send me the Performance Delivery Command Center report for order /order from ${7 days ago} through ${now}.

title: Create media plan
prompt: Create for <advertiser or product website> an awareness Media Plan from <YYYY-MM-DD> to <YYYY-MM-DD> for $<positive amount>, across all channels.
